prompt:
Shared style contract for every Woven Nest layer:
Create 2D side-view pixel art for a melancholic metroidvania room, canvas 688x384 pixels.
Use the attached Woven Nest background only as a mood, palette, and material reference. Do not copy its exact composition, silhouettes, or object placement.
Visual DNA: dark teal forest depth, woven roots and reed-like nest structures, lived-in non-human folk architecture, damp moss, hanging cords, tiny amber and cyan lantern accents, old simple machines rather than modern sci-fi.
Pixel art requirements: crisp pixel clusters, limited muted palette, no anti-aliasing, no painterly blur, no smooth gradients except sparse dithering, no bloom, no soft glow halos, no UI, no text, no watermark, no characters.
Gameplay readability: leave the central play lane less busy than the top, sides, and lower foreground. Do not draw solid collision platforms as final gameplay truth; this is visual background dressing.
Avoid direct Hollow Knight imagery or any recognizable reference-game shapes; borrow only the general idea of separated depth layers for parallax.



Create one opaque full-canvas background layer.

Layer: far_fog.
Canvas: exactly 688x384 pixels, full rectangle filled.
Content: distant teal mist, blurred-by-distance tree/root silhouettes, faint cavern depth, pale cyan haze openings, very low contrast.
Depth role: deepest background behind everything else.
Composition: keep the center readable and quiet; denser silhouette mass near the upper corners and far sides; no foreground objects.
Palette: near-black teal, dark blue-green, desaturated cyan fog, muted moss shadows.
No transparency, no magenta background, no characters, no UI, no text.
